The ledges carry loads; a required removable resin-compatible silicone bead across a rear tab and fixed ledge prevents reverse sliding. Six printed parts, unchanged body height and six M2 case/frame insert locations. Lid and strip change; keeper is new; base/midframe/power slider retain R20 geometry. All six final meshes and source/file hashes passed checks. Base/midframe/power slider hashes match R20. Numerical viewer and browser assembly-view checks passed. Three-page PDF text/hash/dimension audit and final rendered-page inspection passed. Latest viewer browser reinspection passed at seated, entry and lowered positions with no reported errors/warnings. The final 10-file ZIP passed CRC, exact member-byte, and source/STL hash checks. Physical fit and strength unverified.

lid_and_other_access: Both halves follow the same wheel/USB outer contour, with 1 mm total wheel relief, a uniform right rear profile and inward reinforcement; actual lower cavity drives the revised midframe. USB apertures split across the base-owned lower saddle and upper cover for vertical assembly. Full LCD module remains flush with the outer face on a rear support ledge, with 0.2 mm side clearance and optional rear frame-to-seat silicone fillets. Three keys remain 1 mm raised, and outer top/bottom face edges use R2 rounding. Four M2 x 8 mm screws enter closed underside wells and engage blind upper-cover inserts. PCB attaches only to midframe; two independent M2 x 8 mm nylon screws attach that frame to inserts in the base posts. Installed component fit and physical assembly remain unverified. Revision 15 adds a local rounded rear USB cable scallop while preserving the full 4.4 mm case post at (77,41) and all rotary, battery and frame positions. Revision 16 adds the connected battery-lead passage within the midframe and shifts its front PCB seat/stop 4 mm left; the shell floor stays closed. Revision 17 enlarges the LCD flex relief and adds three midframe-owned lid locating keys, with downward-open blind pockets in added lid receiver ribs. Reprint the lid and midframe as a pair; the base and button strip retain revision 16 geometry. Revision 18 opens the battery cable bay through the front/right frame edges, moves its front PCB support left by 5 mm, adds a beveled SW7 opening and moves the front strip fixing to (63,19). New lid, frame and strip are a matched set; base unchanged. Revision 19 replaces the exposed SW7 opening with a separate captive slider, smaller lid slot, underside flange guide and integral retaining shelf on the button strip. Base and midframe retain revision 18 geometry. Revision 20 adds an independent upper PCB travel stop and relocates the lower USB-side seat away from RESET/pads. No preload or clamping force intended; lid must close freely before tightening screws. Base, button strip and power slider retain revision 19 geometry. Revision 21 removes the two button-strip screw pilots and holes; solid roof datums and a separate keeper on four lid ledges retain the strip. Required removable silicone across a rear keeper tab and fixed ledge provides anti-backout retention. Body, display seat and button stem geometry unchanged. Strip may settle 0.15 mm, leaving 0.15 mm nominal button gap; total cap float becomes 0.55 mm.

midframe.assembly_sequence: With electronics removed, install four cover inserts and two base-post inserts, then insert the power cap and drop the strip vertically against its solid roof datums. Lower the keeper at +3.3 mm Y and slide -3.3 mm to the front stop. Check controls, apply and cure a required removable resin-compatible silicone bead across an accessible rear keeper tab and fixed ledge; keep moving features clear. Fit the LCD as appropriate. Attach PCB to midframe using its independent blind mount. Place battery with its lead corner toward (73.5,6). Before seating the frame, route the lead through the open front-right cable bay toward J25; connect while raised and accessible. Keep slack clear of screws/supports and out of the 0.5 mm under-plate gap. Lower the PCB/midframe onto the ledge with USB bodies entering the base saddle open notches. Fasten the front-left and rear M2 x 8 mm frame screws. Connect and route LCD flex, lower cover vertically over its three frame keys and past wheel to close USB notches; confirm free key entry and a closed seam without the anti-lift stop preloading the PCB; do not pull a binding lid down with screws. Insert four M2 x 8 mm nylon case screws from underside wells. Verify screw engagement, no bottoming, button rest gaps, free movement and full SW7 power-slider travel. Physical insertion, lead routing and fit require checking.
